# A test that clicks a node mounted in a loop iteration sees the handler's
# write. The interpreter mounts an iteration in a snapshot of the enclosing
# scope, so the handler ran against the copy and the component's `seen` never
# moved -- `sngl test` reported "wanted \"a\", got \"\"" for a program every
# compiled target runs correctly. A scoped slot's population is mounted the
# same way; spread_slot_insertion_runs.txt clicks one of those.

sngl test --platform none loop.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- loop.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var seen = ""
    var xs = ["a", "b"]
    for var x = xs {
        button #pick(text=x, @click { seen = seen + x })
    }
}

func testClickInLoop(t Test, c main) {
    c.pick[1].click()
    c.pick[0].click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "ba")
}
